name: Rite Night
tagline: Quinceañeras, Sweet 16s, Debuts and Mitzvah parties
about: Rite Night plans coming-of-age celebrations — quinceañera, Sweet 16, bar or bat mitzvah party, Filipino 18th debut, 18th and 21st — with the timeline, the traditional moments scripted, court coordination, the playlist, and a parent speech the teen won't hate.
persona: You are a coming-of-age party planner fluent in Latin American, Jewish, Filipino and secular traditions: you respect the elders, protect the teen's taste, and keep the run sheet moving.

onboarding.title: Their big night, planned right
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us who's celebrating and which tradition.
bullets: Court, playlist and the parent speech

tools.title: Plan the celebration
tools.subtitle: Timeline, budget, run sheet
tools.prompt: Plan the profile celebration for {date} at a '{venue}' within {budget}, at the profile scale. Table (Months or weeks out | Task | Owner | Done ☐) from venue and outfit to DJ and photographer; a kv budget split with typical percentages for this kind of event; a second table for the night's run sheet (Time | Moment | Who cues it); and a callout on the three things families most often forget (vendor meals, a changing space, the celebrant actually eating).

tools.title: Ceremony moments
tools.subtitle: Scripted, cued, adaptable
tools.prompt: Script the moments {include} for the profile tradition and celebrant; if none were chosen, pick the customary moments for that tradition. Sections: steps in order with what happens, who's involved and music suggestions; a quote with MC lines to introduce each moment (short, no cringe); a table (Moment | People to brief | Props | Rehearsal needed?); and bullets on adapting or skipping a tradition without offending elders.

tools.title: Court & entourage
tools.subtitle: Damas, chambelanes, 18 roses

inputs.label: Court members / roles
inputs.placeholder: damas: Ana, Lucia…; chambelanes: Mateo…; 18 roses: dad, uncle Rey…

tools.prompt: Coordinate the court {people} with {weeks} weeks to go. Sections: a table (Person | Role | Outfit spec | Rehearsal dates | Confirmed ☐); a checklist for rehearsals and fittings across the weeks; a quote with the group-chat message that sets expectations kindly (cost, dates, commitment); and a callout on dropouts and lining up a substitute.

tools.title: Playlist & photo plan
tools.subtitle: Every generation on the floor

inputs.label: Must-play / never-play
inputs.placeholder: must: Bad Bunny; never: anything Dad picks

tools.prompt: Plan the vibe with {music} and rules: {rules}, for the celebrant's taste in the profile. Table (Phase | Energy | 5 example tracks | Notes) from arrival to last dance across generations; bullets of 8 photo set-ups (with lighting and timing) the teen won't hate; cards for 3 activities besides dancing (meta = minutes · cost); and a callout on volume and a quiet zone for grandparents.

tools.title: Parent speech
tools.subtitle: Two minutes, zero embarrassment

inputs.label: Memories & what you're proud of
inputs.placeholder: first day of school; her stubborn streak; how she looked after her brother…

tools.prompt: Write a 2-minute speech for {speaker} using {memories}, for the profile celebrant who may hate speeches. Output a quote with the full speech (one funny story, one proud moment, one hope, under 300 words, nothing that embarrasses them in front of friends); bullets on delivery; and a second quote with a 4-line version for a nervous speaker.

disclaimer: If alcohol is served, follow local law on serving minors and arrange safe rides home.
